business_problem: Zhongkewenge needed scalable cloud infrastructure for data-intensive media, city-governance, and decision-intelligence products. Its workloads involved frequent large-scale storage reads, multilingual and multimodal AI processing, and customer-facing systems that required better cost efficiency and operations focus than self-managed infrastructure could provide.
solution_summary: Zhongkewenge partnered with Alibaba Cloud to run its media- and decision-intelligence platforms on cloud infrastructure built around ECS big-data instances. The company's products combine data intelligence, AI, and decision engines across media operations, city governance, financial analysis, and broader enterprise scenarios, including the Red Flag intelligent media operating system and the Tianhu big-data intelligence platform. To support those workloads, Alibaba Cloud ECS provides the core compute layer and helps Zhongkewenge build a cloud Hadoop environment for high-frequency data reads and large-scale log analysis. Business-system logs flow into Hadoop for analytics, while analysis results can be stored in MySQL or NoSQL systems such as HBase, MongoDB, and Redis for serving. This lets Zhongkewenge focus on product and algorithm innovation while running multilingual, multimodal AI and data-analysis services on a more elastic and cost-effective cloud foundation.

solution_components.name: Elastic Compute Service (ECS)
solution_components.role: Provides the core compute infrastructure for Zhongkewenge's media and decision-intelligence products.

solution_components.name: Hadoop big-data system
solution_components.role: Stores and analyzes large-scale logs and operational data generated by customer systems.

solution_components.name: MySQL
solution_components.role: Stores analysis results for downstream business serving.

solution_components.name: HBase
solution_components.role: Supports large-scale NoSQL serving for analyzed data assets.

data_flow: Multilingual media and operational data is collected into Zhongkewenge's AI and data platforms, transmitted into a Hadoop big-data system on Alibaba Cloud for analysis, and then served back to applications through MySQL or NoSQL stores. Those outputs support media workflows, city-governance dashboards, and decision-intelligence products.
integration_points: Red Flag intelligent media operating system
business_outcome: Zhongkewenge gained a cloud foundation that can support large data volumes and frequent analysis without distracting the team from its core AI products. The company has continued to scale industry products and customers while Alibaba Cloud absorbs more of the infrastructure burden behind them.
architecture_clues: Zhongkewenge separates batch analytics on Hadoop from serving layers in MySQL and NoSQL stores.
The same AI and data platform supports media, city, financial, and enterprise scenarios instead of a single vertical application.
Cloud ECS big-data instances are used as the cost-performance base for high-read analytical workloads.
